description:
Courses on Khan Academy are always 100% free. Start practicing—and saving your progress—now! 

Explore how limited resources like food, water, and space shape population growth in ecosystems. As populations increase, competition for resources intensifies, slowing population growth or even causing declines. Locust swarms show how resource availability directly controls how large or small populations can become over time.
